about: The pMek measurements behind Fig 6B, 6C and 6D of Fritsche-Guenther et al. 2011, by data level. Levels: A raw readings or per-replicate source data as measured; B author-processed data; C summary values reported in a table; D values read off a figure (estimates); E qualitative statements in text or legend. Numbers marked B are copied from the authors' files with their line numbers (extracted.json). Numbers marked D are the host's readings of the rendered PDF page and are estimates. Nothing here is level A.

6B.what: pMek (Bio-Plex beads for P-Mek1 S217/S221; the file header says 'Phosphoplex measurements') in HCT116, SW480, HT29, RKO after U0126 at 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 uM; controls untreated, DMSO and PBS.
6B.time: 24 h in the results text ('we measured pMek levels 24 h post-inhibition'); neither the legend nor the source data file states a time.
6B.unit: Dimensionless ratio. The file header: 'normalised to PBS treated cells'; column: 'Measurement relative to PBS'. Each line's PBS row is 1 by definition. The axis reads 'pMek (relative)', log-scaled inhibitor axis.
6B.values_per_condition: 1 value at 1, 10, 20, 50 and 100 uM; 2 values at 0.5 and 5 uM; untreated 2, DMSO 1, PBS 1 (the reference). Each line's three control rows appear a second time, verbatim, at the end of its block; these are repeats in the file, not further measurements, and are not counted. In the SW480 block the repeated rows carry concentration 0.3 instead of 0 (not interpreted).
6B.error_bars: None in the panel. The legend's 'mean and s.d. of three replicates' follows the description of panel D; with one or two values per condition, it does not describe 6B.
6B.file_header_calls_it: Raw data of Figure 6B. It is level B: the values are ratios to PBS, not instrument readings.

6C.what: pMek in SW480 and HCT116 at 0, 30, 60, 120, 180 and 240 min after AZD6244.
6C.concentration: 1 uM AZD6244 per the Bio-Plex methods; neither the legend nor the file states it for this panel.
6C.unit: Ratio 'normalised by one 0-timepoint' (file column label). Three rows at t=0; one of them is 1.0 by definition. The legend says the t=0 controls are untreated and DMSO-treated samples; the file does not say which row is which.
6C.values_per_condition: one value per time point after 0.

levels: D (host reading of the rendered figure)
6D.source_data: None in the open-access package: the manifest lists df6B and df6C only. The review process file says 6D was added during revision ('new Figure 6D').
6D.what: pMek in RKO, HT29 (B-Raf V600E) and HCT116, SW480 (B-Raf WT) at 30, 60 and 120 min with (filled) or without (open) AZD6244, alone (squares), with cycloheximide (circles) or with actinomycin D (triangles).
6D.concentrations: AZD6244 1 uM, cycloheximide 10 ug/ml, actinomycin D 5 ug/ml (Bio-Plex methods, not the legend).
6D.unit: 'mean and s.d. of three replicates relative to untreated samples at 0 time point' (legend). Axis 'pMEK', 0-8, linear.
6D.statistics: 'No significant difference between feedback action in cells with non-inhibited gene expression ... and cells with inhibited expression' (legend); the test is not named. No test is reported for inhibitor against no inhibitor.

readings.method: Looked at page 9 of the PMC PDF rendered at 300 dpi (crops of the four panels). Values are read against the axis ticks (0, 2, 4, 6, 8); the reading uncertainty is about +/-0.3 near 1 and +/-0.5 above 2, larger for error-bar ends. One decimal is the most the rendering supports.

AZD6244_alone_sd_range.120: about 1.5 to beyond the axis top (8)

RKO.all_symbols: about 1.0 to 1.2 at every time, with and without AZD6244; error bars small at this scale

HT29.all_symbols: about 0.7 to 1.1 at every time, with and without AZD6244

checklist.detail: HCT116 and SW480 K-Ras exon 2 (D13E, G12V); HT29 and RKO B-Raf V600E (Results, lit-03d068babab3). 6B has all four lines; 6C only SW480 and HCT116; 6D all four.
6B: U0126 0.5-100 uM, 24 h (text only), untreated/DMSO/PBS, values relative to PBS. 6C: AZD6244 1 uM (methods), 0-240 min. 6D: AZD6244 1 uM, 30-120 min, +/- CHX or ActD, relative to untreated at t0.
checklist.affects: which condition the model's single 'MEKi on' may stand for; it is not fixed by the data

checklist.detail: MEK1 phosphorylated at S217/S221 (Bio-Plex bead). Not total MEK, not MEK activity.
checklist.affects: pMek is the model's pMEK only under the identity readout; MEK kinase activity under the inhibitor is a different quantity

checklist.detail: Bio-Plex Protein Array system (Bio-Rad), Bio-Plex Manager software, beads and detection antibodies diluted 1:5. No catalogue or lot number.
checklist.affects: no manufacturer range can be tied to this kit

checklist.detail: ratios: to PBS (6B), to one t0 sample (6C), to untreated t0 (6D).
checklist.affects: no absolute level; the untreated level is 1 by construction, not a measured position on the assay's range

checklist.detail: not in methods, legend, supplement or source data.
checklist.affects: whether untreated pMek is clearly above background (present) or near it (absent) cannot be decided

checklist.item: normalisation to protein, cell number or loading
checklist.detail: lysate protein measured by BCA; whether readings were adjusted to it, or equal protein loaded, is not stated.
checklist.affects: small differences near 1 (e.g. RKO 0.4-0.6 in 6B) could partly reflect loading

checklist.detail: every available value is a ratio.
6B: 1-2 values per condition, no error bars; 6C: one series; 6D: three replicates, unit unstated.
checklist.affects: 6B and 6C directions are single or duplicate measurements; 6D gives a spread

checklist.detail: only 'no significant difference' between expression-inhibited and non-inhibited feedback action in 6D, test unnamed.
checklist.affects: no tested statement that the inhibitor increased pMek; the increase is a direction read from the values

checklist.item: detection or quantification range, saturation, dilution, standard curve
checklist.detail: only the 1:5 dilution of beads and detection antibodies is stated.
checklist.affects: whether the treated maximum (about 6x in HCT116) is inside a linear range, and where untreated sits in it

checklist.detail: 6C and 6D are separate experiments (6C has no CHX/ActD arms and different time points); 6B is a separate dose experiment at 24 h.
checklist.affects: the panels are not one series and are not pooled

observations.statement: pMek relative to PBS rises above the line's control values at 5-50 uM U0126 in HCT116 (2.10 and 1.16 at 5; 3.61 at 10; 4.92 at 20; 6.01 at 50) and at 5-20 uM in SW480 (1.23 and 2.18 at 5; 1.57 at 10; 3.81 at 20). Controls: HCT116 0.79-1.11, SW480 0.88-1.12.
At 0.5 and 1 uM U0126 the values lie within or near the control values (HCT116 0.90, 1.07, 0.78; SW480 0.72, 1.09, 0.92).

At the highest doses the values fall far below the controls: HCT116 0.084 at 100 uM; SW480 0.25 at 50 and 0.020 at 100 uM. HCT116 is at its maximum at 50 uM, so 'exceeding 20 uM, phospho-Mek levels drop in all cell lines' (text) holds for SW480 but not for HCT116 at 50 uM.
HT29: 0.98-1.48 at 0.5-10 uM against controls 0.68-1.07; then 0.40, 0.073, 0.027 at 20, 50, 100 uM. No increase is seen beyond the 1.48 single value at 0.5 uM.

RKO: 0.39-0.63 at every dose from 0.5 to 10 uM, against controls 1.04-1.17; 0.15, 0.012, 0.004 at 20, 50, 100 uM. Every U0126 value is below every RKO control value (one or two values per dose, no statistics).

With AZD6244 alone, mean pMek in HCT116 and SW480 is above the no-inhibitor means at 30, 60 and 120 min (about 2-6 against about 1.2-1.4). At 120 min the s.d. is wide (HCT116 about 1.9-7.7; SW480 lower end about 1.5).
RKO and HT29 stay at about 0.7-1.2 with and without AZD6244 up to 120 min.

Without AZD6244, mean pMek in HCT116 and SW480 stays at about 1.2-1.4 at 30, 60 and 120 min; the text says pMek 'remains constant under vehicle control'. These are population means of three replicates at three time points.
